posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
Harroshii said:
In the 3rd Screenshot you can see that all my Plugins are imported and also activated.
Click to expand...
two things to note that may be relevant to you:
first, whenever you install a plugin you should also save your project. the plugin configuration data isnt updated when you add a plugin to the list.
the other thing is that you want to test plugins using a new game. oftentimes plugins set up required data only when new game starts. in those cases, adding a plugin after the save file has been created often prevents the plugin from working properly.

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body: You can also press F12 while playtesting to open the dev console and go to the "console" tab. When a plugin crashes, this is the spot where you will see its error messages!
